notes: The shell's frame (#902, #967): the chrome the page draws around a screen, measured against the shell's own at 393. It is a pair of states, because the page has two chromes and a screen must not drift from one into the other. `at-rest` is the primary frame - the top bar `Navbar` draws and the bottom bar `BottomTabBar` draws - recorded on `/`, the one every member can reach with no session; `origin` is the top bar because the two clients' windows are not the same height: the design is the bars' own boxes and the gap the frame leaves between them, not where the frame starts. `secondary` is the drill-down frame - no bar, no title, the floating back control `SecondaryHeader` draws and the band `#main-content` reserves - recorded on `/account/faq`, a real secondary page. There is no `capture`: the page's bars are glass over the page's content, and the account tab has the member's avatar floated over it, so a raster of the frame is a raster of the hero and of the session - the gate entry's `why` says why the frame is contract-only. Colours - the active tab's violet, the bar's tint - are not measured for the same reason: they are composited against content the app does not draw. The services sheet is a state of its own (it opens over the frame), not the frame at rest.
